fieldName.description: The name of the field on a type that is used inside a {@link PdfComponent}.

label.description: The label used to display on the field in the {@link PdfComponent}.

placeholder.description: The text to display in the component field if no value is present for the {@link PdfComponentFieldSpec#fieldName}.

colorSpec.description: Specifies the color and how to fill the color for each field.

title: Base PDF spec that specifies the information about a field in a {@link PdfComponent}.
name: PdfComponentFieldSpec
